posts.hook: Blurry notes are not your enemy
posts.title: Turn photos of scattered notes into one study guide
posts.payoff: Deciphering shaky handwriting is now optional.
moves: Snap clear photos of your notes (yours or a comrade's).
Upload all the images to an AI like Gemini or ChatGPT.
Ask: 'Combine into one summary with key terms and 10 quiz questions.'
Screenshot the summary and send it to your class group.
posts.caption:
AI Hack: messy notes into one clean study guide, in minutes. Save this before the next CAT catches you unprepared.

#AIHack #JuaKesho

critic.note: The AI-notes hack is common advice; sharpen with a more specific Kenyan pain point (e.g., exam CAT tomorrow) to feel less generic.

posts.claim: Football clubs only use AI for highlight reels and nothing else.
posts.real: Clubs also lean on AI and data analytics for scouting, tactics and injury prevention, the same stats behind matches like Chelsea vs Arsenal in the WSL.
posts.source: WSL match analytics widely reported by broadcasters, e.g. BBC Sport (search: Chelsea vs Arsenal WSL stats)
posts.caption:
Cap or No Cap? 'AI in football is just for highlight reels.' CAP. Data is deciding lineups now. Tag the friend who thinks tech and football don't mix.

#CapOrNoCap #JuaKesho

critic.note: Source citation is vague ('search:'), which undercuts credibility—swap for a concrete stat or quote.

posts.title: The 'Pay To Get Paid' Loan Trick
posts.sms: Congratulations! You qualify for KES 50,000. Pay KES 1,500 activation fee to receive funds today.
tips: A real lender never asks for money before disbursing a loan.
Check if the lender is licensed on the CBK digital lenders list.
Report the number to your telco and block it immediately.
posts.caption:
Usiibiwe! If a 'loan' asks you to pay first, it's not a loan, it's bait. Send this to the comrade waiting on hustle capital.

#Usiibiwe #JuaKesho

warnings: states facts but has no `source`; verify before approving

critic.note: Solid and useful, but the loan-scam warning format is common—add a fresh twist like a real recent scam number or platform name.

posts.name: Elsa Majimbo

Put Us On: Elsa Majimbo, Kenya. Started with a phone camera and her own voice, now the world is watching. Follow, laugh, then send this to someone who thinks 'made in Kenya' can't go global.

scripts.radio: Sasa, Wanakesho! Jua hapa. Leo tunaongea biashara na teknolojia. Umewahi ona mama mboga akiuza kupitia simu hata usiku? Hiyo si uchawi, ni WhatsApp Business, free app inayoweza kujibu wateja automatic ukiwa umelala. Boda wetu kwenye comic wiki hii bado hajaamini, lakini mfuko wa mama mboga unaongezeka bila yeye kuamka! Hiyo ndiyo maana tunasema, kesho iko hapa, sio inakuja. Halafu tuna Put Us On wiki hii: Elsa Majimbo, dada kutoka Nairobi ambaye alianza na simu tu, sasa dunia nzima inamjua. Hiyo inaonyesha, hauhitaji studio kubwa ku-start, unahitaji simu na ujasiri wa ku-post. Kwa mtu anayeuza mtaani au anataka kuanza content, hii ni wiki ya kujaribu kitu kimoja kipya: fungua WhatsApp Business, au anza kupost content yako bila kuogopa. Kwa Kiswahili kwa ufupi: wiki hii tunaonyesha jinsi biashara ndogo zinaweza kutumia teknolojia bure kuuza hata usiku, na tunamwangazia muumba wa Kikenya ambaye amefika mbali kwa kutumia simu tu. Fuata, jaribu, na ushirikishe rafiki yako. Kesho iko hapa, Wanakesho!
scripts.voice_note: Eh Wanakesho, sasa! Leo tuko na story fupi ya mama mboga fulani, huyu jamaa ame-set WhatsApp Business auto-reply, sasa anauza hata akiwa amelala. Wateja wanaandika, simu inajibu automatic, mzigo unaenda kesho asubuhi. Boda mmoja hapo hataki kuamini, lakini pesa inaingia tu. Ukiwa na biashara ndogo, hii ni free feature, tafuta WhatsApp Business, weka auto-reply, umalize. Halafu tumeangazia pia Elsa Majimbo, msichana wa Kenya ambaye alianza na simu tu, sasa anajulikana dunia nzima. Kama unafikiria huwezi anza content bila vitu vingi, huyu ni proof unaweza. Sawa basi, jaribu kitu kimoja leo, sio kesho. Tuonane wiki ijayo, Wanakesho, kesho iko hapa!
scripts.sms: Usiibiwe: Hakuna 'customer care' halali inayokuuliza M-Pesa PIN kwa simu au SMS. Ukiona hivyo, kata simu, usijibu. Weka siri PIN yako.
scripts.reels: Picha ya mama mboga akiuza usiku bila kuamka... boda akishangaa... halafu Elsa Majimbo akiongea kwa simu tu, dunia ikimsikiliza. Kesho Kutwa: biashara ndogo zinaenda digital, waumbaji wadogo wanaenda global. Swali ni, wewe uko wapi kwenye hii mstari? Save hii, jaribu kitu kimoja leo. Kesho iko hapa.
